newsitem.title: UK: Phillips shuts in 300,000 bpd Ekofisk crude.
newsitem.headline: Phillips shuts in 300,000 bpd Ekofisk crude.

text.p: Phillips Norway has shut in about 300,000 barrels per day (bpd) of Ekofisk crude output because of corrosion to a pipeline, a trading source familiar with company operations said on Tuesday.
"All production that goes through the Ekofisk Centre has been suspended until Saturday," the trader said.
Production was closed down on Tuesday and repairs on a four metre section of pipeline were expected to take about five days.
Ekofisk satellite fields output, running at just over 200,000 bpd, was not affected.
Phillips told equity holders that, as a result of the repairs, it would delay the announcement of its February Ekofisk loading programme.
No decision has yet been made on cancellations of January Ekofisk liftings.
"January cargoes will be loaded as and when but there's bound to be some impact on the programme," said a trader.
Norway's Ekofisk crude is piped to the Teesside terminal in northeast England where loadings run at about 520,000 bpd.
